title: Snow Crash
author: Neal Stephenson
summary: A pizza deliveryman who is also a master hacker finds a dangerous new drug that works inside a virtual world. It leads him into a conflict among franchised city-states, an eccentric media tycoon and a sword-wielding young courier.
readIf: you want zany, idea-packed cyberpunk with a satirical eye on corporations and religion.
skipIf: you dislike long info-dumps about language and history that interrupt the action.

pairings.reason: The cooler, more atmospheric father of the genre, which this book riffs on.
A simpler and more nostalgic virtual-world adventure that is easier to enter.
Equally comic and inventive in satirising its society, though gentler and more absurd.
